summary: Acceptance is incomplete: the all-rule composition implementation is absent. Independent probes also found an inexact frozen-transition comparison, overwritten per-link role operands, and an InstrumentRun rejection guard whose removal survives all new role tests.

Compared the changes with L12-A2d and the sealed Plan; implementation and tests address the assigned prerequisite work.

src/eval_lab/lint_role_prerequisites.py:214-217 and :284-288 discard the association between each link and its registration/evidence/run timing operands.

Verified backlog ownership keeps final rule predicates in L12-B, the exhaustive matrix in L12-A3 and readiness/snapshot integration in L12-C.

blocking_findings.description: The required all-rule composition layer does not exist. The only new implementation returns a partial role group; there is no production rule manifest, checked complete scope, independent expected-consumption inventory or conjunction with the temporal and warrant groups. All 30 conjunction tests stop at the missing-module assertion according to the supplied gate. The proposal explicitly retaining an incomplete attempt does not satisfy the sealed acceptance.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Complete the planned composition and independent declaration/consumption checks, with active and inactive rule coverage and diagnostic propagation, and pass the conjunction tests. If the authorized size contingency prevents completion, keep this attempt incomplete and non-integrable until acceptance-preserving replanning is authorized.

blocking_findings.description: Frozen authored-content correspondence uses ordinary Python dictionary equality, which conflates distinct JSON types. In an isolated execution of the actual preparation and digest functions, a draft with sample_design.n_per_arm=true and its frozen successor with n_per_arm=1, with recomputed valid outer hashes, predecessor pin and frozen digest, produced no diagnostics and usable support. This both conceals the changed authored transition and admits the corrupt draft operand. The existing changed-protocol test does not distinguish this case.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Compare authored content with type-preserving structural or canonical equality and validate the relevant predecessor operands. Add direct and retained raw-data controls for boolean/integer substitutions with otherwise valid hashes and pins, asserting a literal integrity diagnostic and denied support.

blocking_findings.description: The InstrumentRun arm-membership guard lacks its own deletion-sensitive negative control. The unknown-arm case exercises EvidenceArm, while the run/link arm mismatch uses a valid second arm and tests a different guard. Independently disabling only arm membership for InstrumentRun made a run with a nonexistent arm usable without diagnostics, while all 514 parameterized direct role-test cases still passed. The field matrix treats arm as text and cannot detect this semantic omission.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Add an isolated InstrumentRun-root unknown-arm test with valid surrounding dependencies, exact literal subject/state/path/reason, a valid counterpart and a targeted deletion witness on both adapters. Audit distinct branches sharing guard labels so one branch's control is not counted as coverage for another.

blocking_findings.description: Role timing operands are stored in three group-global dictionary slots and overwritten for every link. The per-pair freeze tuple retains only hypothesis-before-freeze and membership, without the link identity or its registration/evidence/run timing results. An isolated two-evidence resolution probe returned registration_after_freeze=false and run_after_freeze=null in one submitted-evidence order, then true/true when that order was reversed, with no diagnostics in either case. A consumer cannot safely associate these exported operands with each pair.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Retain the complete checked timing operands under each exact evidence/hypothesis/link/plan/arm association. Add a multi-evidence or multi-link fixture with deliberately different timing results and literal per-association expectations, including reordered-input controls.

claims_for_research.claim: Python 3.12 compares aware datetimes with different fixed UTC offsets by represented instants, including equality of 2026-09-30T17:00:01-07:00 and 2026-10-01T00:00:01Z.

flags: Full installed-package pytest execution was unavailable: the accessible Python lacks pytest, pydantic and SQLAlchemy. The 6127-pass/30-failure result is supplied harness evidence.

Independent executions used actual repository preparation, reader, canonicalization and test functions with substituted import wiring and an artifact-kind registry. Test parameterization was invoked manually; SQLite tables were in memory with query_only enabled. These checks do not establish on-disk retained integration.

Reviewed I1-I16 against the complete diff and relevant behavior. No new human judgment authoring, history writes, protected-file changes, operational policy execution, averaging, probability arithmetic, runtime networking, public serialization, existing-test weakening, deferred implementation or harness modification was found. No score-zero invariant violation is asserted.

Supplied gate.json also reports blocking G12 approval failure. G5, G6 and G14 pass in that supplied evidence; their external repository/filesystem claims were not independently rechecked outside the permitted folder.
